rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Health questions test both vocabulary (diet, fitness, well-being) and argument — give reasons.
Remember: exercise benefits body AND mind; mention both for full marks.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Health passages are data-heavy — circle numbers and comparatives (more, less, twice) while reading; comprehension questions target them.  ·  Trick 2: Essay questions on exercise expect a structured argument: claim → two benefits with reasons → one counter-view (no time) → rebuttal → conclusion.

rows.text: Q. Why do young people exercise less today? Suggest two reasons. (2 marks) — screen time and busy schedules; add one solution.
